exclusions: Pre-existing medical conditions not formally declared and underwritten prior to commencement
Elective plastic surgery, cosmetic enhancements, and non-prescribed treatments
Intentionally self-inflicted harm, suicide attempts, or dangerous reckless conduct
Injuries resulting from professional motorsports, skydiving, or undeclared extreme sports
Hospitalization and care received outside designated network institutions without pre-approval
War crimes, armed conflict, civil insurrection, radioactive contamination, or nuclear events
Rehabilitation and medical therapy relating to alcohol dependency, chemical abuse, or illegal drugs
In-vitro fertilization (IVF), elective fertility programs, and surrogacy-related care
Experimental medications, off-label clinical treatments, and non-certified gene therapies
Routine physical assessments and medical checks unrelated to acute sickness or injury diagnosis
Rest cures, convalescent sanatorium admissions, and long-term palliative custodial nursing
Acquisition of non-prescribed holistic health products, dietary boosters, or folk remedies
Treatment obtained in territories subject to international sanctions and trade embargoes

network.notes: Direct cashierless settlement enabled worldwide across all accredited tertiary medical hospitals.
